# FrontLoop

> FrontLoop is an autonomous B2B WhatsApp AI front desk for Indian small and medium businesses: multi-specialty clinics, diagnostic centres, coaching academies, salons, boutiques and local service providers. It replies to customer WhatsApp inquiries 24/7 in about 3 seconds, answers only from each business's verified knowledge base, captures leads into a CRM dashboard, and hands conversations to human staff on request. Based in Calicut, Kerala, India.

## Contact

- Website: https://frontloop.online
- Email: trueattendly@gmail.com

## What it does

- Instant 24/7 replies on the business's own WhatsApp number, including nights, Sundays and holidays.
- Answers questions on services, doctor or faculty timings, fees, prices, location and operating hours using only the business's configured knowledge base. It does not invent prices or policies.
- Understands English, Malayalam context and mixed English-Malayalam (Manglish) phrasing.
- Captures the customer's name, phone, intent and requirement into a lead pipeline with New, Contacted, Converted and Lost stages, filtering, search and CSV export.
- One-click human takeover pauses the bot on any conversation, and staff reply to the customer from the dashboard (within WhatsApp's 24-hour service window). Chats where the customer asked for a person are grouped under Needs Human.
- Inbound-first: replies to customers who message the business. It does not send bulk or unsolicited broadcasts.

## Architecture

- Next.js 16 App Router, full-stack and serverless (Route Handlers and Server Actions on Vercel).
- Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph API v21.0) for receiving webhooks and sending replies. No unofficial QR-code or WhatsApp Web automation.
- MongoDB (Mongoose) with strict per-tenant isolation: every lead, message and knowledge-base query is scoped to the business's tenant ID.
- AI lead automation pipeline: webhook messages are processed in the background with Next.js `after()`, with a cron sweeper retrying unprocessed replies.
- WhatsApp access tokens encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM; webhook signatures verified with constant-time comparison.
- Payments in INR via Cashfree.
